points.name: apps.flashlight.white_register
points.interpretation: Registers white-mode callback 0x0c508985 with filter 0 and user data 0.

points.name: apps.flashlight.blink_register
points.interpretation: Registers blink-mode callback 0x0c508a29 with filter 0 and user data 0.

points.name: apps.flashlight.red_register
points.interpretation: Registers red-mode callback 0x0c508acd with filter 0 and user data 0.

points.name: apps.flashlight.page_register
points.interpretation: Registers main callback 0x0c5084e9 with filter 0 when the flashlight page is allowed to open.

points.name: apps.flashlight.white_event_code
points.interpretation: The white-mode callback reads the event code and reacts to code 4.

points.name: apps.flashlight.blink_event_code
points.interpretation: The blink-mode callback reads the event code and reacts to code 4.

points.name: apps.flashlight.red_event_code
points.interpretation: The red-mode callback reads the event code and reacts to code 4.

points.name: apps.flashlight.page_event_code
points.interpretation: The main callback switches on event codes 11, 12 and 36.

points.name: apps.flashlight.warning_icon
points.interpretation: The warning view uses low.bin after the warning alarm setup succeeds.

evidence: The flashlight manifest registers the main descriptor; create stores its root. The normal view registers separate main, white, blink and red callbacks with filter 0. The mode callbacks fetch event code 4 and choose a navigation or animation path; the main callback checks other event codes. The alternate warning builder displays an icon and two localized strings.
scope: Only listed callback registration, event-code reads and warning display calls. Battery policy, physical display brightness and other paths remain outside this scope.
limitations: Altering event processing can interfere with dismissal, animation or page state. Image resources must stay valid while used. State slots are not thread barriers; shared-entry publication and rollback require system-wide quiescence. Device behavior remains unverified.
